2609.06063.title: Explaining AI Agents Through Execution Traces
2609.06063.paper_summary: AI Agents are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, where they interact with external tools and make sequential decisions with limited human oversight. This creates a pressing need for reliable and auditable explanations of what an agent did and why. However, traditional Explainable AI (XAI) methods fall short of providing the process-level transparency required for such interactive, multi-step systems, motivating a paradigm shift toward approaches specifically designed for AI Agents. To address this gap, we present a post-hoc XAI framework that transforms a lengthy agent's execution trace into a structured report and a faithful natural-language explanation explicitly grounded in its observable behavior. Because it relies solely on execution traces, the framework applies across different agent architectures, environments, and tasks. Human and automated evaluations across multiple benchmarks and architectures show that our framework produces high-quality, trace-faithful explanations while reliably identifying unsupported claims, unjustified actions, and evidence gaps, outperforming naive LLM-generated explanations.
2609.06063.paper_summary_zh: AI代理人越來越多地被部署在現實世界的環境中，在這些環境中，它們與外部工具互動並在有限的人類監督下做出連續決策。<lb/>這就產生了對於代理人所做的事情及其原因的可靠且可審計的解釋的迫切需求。<lb/>然而，傳統的可解釋人工智慧（XAI）方法未能提供這種互動式、多步驟系統所需的過程級透明度，這促使我們朝著專門為AI代理人設計的方法進行範式轉變。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們提出了一個事後可解釋AI框架，該框架將冗長的代理人執行軌跡轉換為結構化報告和忠實的自然語言解釋，明確基於其可觀察行為。<lb/>因為它僅依賴於執行軌跡，這個框架適用於不同的代理架構、環境和任務。<lb/>在多個基準和架構上的人類和自動評估顯示，我們的框架產生高質量、忠實於軌跡的解釋，同時可靠地識別不支持的主張、不合理的行動和證據缺口，表現優於天真的LLM生成的解釋。
